newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.94 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.94 pct in March.

text.p: Brazil's real closed at 1.0610 per dollar, down 0.19 percent in the day and 0.94 percent in the month on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.

Before the trading session opened, the Central Bank set a new weaker reais-dollar mini-band of between 1.0570 and 1.0620 reais per dollar. The mini-band was lowered 0.57 percent during March, the same decline as in February.
The previous mini-band was set on March 17 at between 1.0565 and 1.0615 reais per dollar.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0625 to the dollar, down 0.03 percent in the day and down 0.58 percent in the month.
In the illegal parallel market, the real fell 3.83 percent in March, closing at 1.140 per dollar, traders said.
